investigation_type: Fake Job Recruitment / Government Impersonation OSINT

company.verification: The Ministry of Rural Development stated that NRDRM does not work under its purview and that the recruitment activities had no government endorsement.

mord_warning.finding: The Ministry stated that NRDRM does not work under its purview and that its recruitment activities in the Ministry's name had no government endorsement.
mord_warning.additional_warning: The Ministry stated that it does not charge any fee at any stage of its recruitment process.
mord_warning.source: Official PIB / Ministry of Rural Development warning

government_action.finding: The Department reported a fake NRDRM website impersonating Department content and stated that I4C was requested to take down the fraudulent websites.
actions: I4C requested to take down fraudulent NRDRM websites
Related NRDRM websites removed from the Internet
government_action.source: Official PIB / Ministry of Rural Development follow-up

red_flags: False association with the Ministry of Rural Development
Use of websites associated with the fraudulent recruitment operation
Government enforcement action including website takedown and FIR

assessment.conclusion: Official Government of India sources strongly indicate that the NRDRM recruitment operation was unauthorized and falsely associated with the Ministry of Rural Development.
assessment.limitation: This OSINT investigation identifies indicators based on publicly available evidence and does not independently establish criminal liability.
